chunks: And from him, from Humayd, from Ibn Sama'ah, from Muhammad ibn Ziyad, from Abdullah ibn Sinan, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him), who said:
I asked him about the woman who is divorced three times in accordance with the Sunnah, whether she has the right to residence (housing) or maintenance (nafaqah). He said, 'No.'

key_terms.عَلَى السُّنَّةِ: In accordance with the Sunnah (prophetic tradition/method)

ai.seo_question: Does a woman divorced three times at once receive housing and maintenance in Shia jurisprudence?
ai.summary: This hadith from *Tahdhib al-Ahkam* clarifies the specific legal consequence of a triple divorce pronounced in the 'Sunnah' manner (typically three divorces in one sitting or session), where the wife is entitled to neither housing nor maintenance during her *Iddah*. This ruling highlights the distinct Shia jurisprudential view that such a divorce is effective immediately, severing the financial obligations that typically accompany a revocable divorce, thereby distinguishing it from the Hanafi perspective on the same scenario.
